strengths_deep_dive: Humanity for Relief and Development demonstrates a high level of operational efficiency for its size. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="10">78.1% of total expenses</cite> were directed toward program services. This is supported by a very low fundraising overhead, as the charity spends only <cite id="7">6% of its budget on professional fundraising</cite>. Furthermore, the organization has achieved the <cite id="6">Candid Platinum Seal</cite> by tracking <cite id="12">six distinct outcome metrics</cite>, which is uncommon for many mid-sized humanitarian groups. This transparency is paired with a <cite id="13">100/100 score in Leadership and Adaptability</cite> from Charity Navigator, suggesting a well-governed institution capable of responding to the volatile conditions in Yemen and Gaza.
rich_narrative.summary: Humanity for Relief and Development (HRD) is a humanitarian organization focused on providing critical aid to families in Yemen and other crisis zones. Founded in <cite id="1">2018</cite>, the charity has rapidly scaled its operations to address food security and medical needs. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="2">$3,669,260 in total revenue</cite> to support its relief programs. HRD maintains a high <cite id="3">Charity Navigator score of 97.3/100</cite>, which reflects a strong commitment to transparency and accountability. The organization is particularly noted for its <cite id="4">Mercy Bakery and Mercy Kitchen programs</cite>, which provide daily nutrition to vulnerable populations, including cancer patients and displaced families. Its operations are <cite id="5">Zakat-eligible</cite>, allowing Muslim donors to fulfill their religious obligations through specific aid categories like the poor and needy. While the organization is relatively young, it has achieved a <cite id="6">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>, indicating a high level of public disclosure regarding its goals and metrics. The charity operates with a lean fundraising model, spending only <cite id="7">$0.06 to raise every $1</cite> in revenue. This efficiency allows a significant portion of donations to reach direct services. HRD primarily serves <cite id="8">Yemen and Gaza</cite>, focusing on regions where conflict has severely disrupted local food systems and healthcare access.
